name: Pantera

whyMatters.en: Texas band that left early glam records for down-tuned groove metal. Vulgar Display of Power (1992) and Far Beyond Driven set mid-90s US metal radio weight.
whyMatters.zh: 德州乐队：离开早期 glam 录音，转向降调 groove metal。Vulgar Display of Power（1992）与 Far Beyond Driven 定下 90 年代中期美国金属电台重量。

lyricQuotes: Can't you see I'm easily bothered by the way
Out of my way / Out of my day

shortBio.en: Dimebag / Anselmo groove metal; Walk is the mid-tempo palm-muted reference.
shortBio.zh: Dimebag / Anselmo 的 groove metal；Walk 是中速掌闷参照。

body.en:
Formed in 1981 in Arlington, Texas (early glam albums exist). Cowboys from Hell (1990) onward is the relevant era—Dimebag Darrell's pinched harmonics, Rex Brown's bass, Vinnie Paul's clicky kick, Phil Anselmo's bark.

Walk (1992) centers groove over speed. They shift US metal away from thrash racing toward stalled, palm-muted riffs that nu-metal and metalcore later inherit.

Darrell Abbott and Vinnie Paul Abbott started the band in Arlington, Texas, in 1981, first as Kiss-style glam built around Darrell’s playing. Rex Brown (“Rexx Rocker”) joined; Terry Glaze was the longest-serving early singer. Four albums came out on their own Metal Magic label. Glaze was replaced by Philip Anselmo in 1987 and the set moved toward hard rock and thrash; Atco, under Atlantic, signed them. Cowboys from Hell (1990) is the book’s marker for the synced riff and double-kick sound. Vulgar Display of Power (1992) answered the thrash audience with Walk, A New Level, and Fucking Hostile. On the world tour Darrell, now called Dimebag, was placed after Eddie Van Halen and Randy Rhoads in guitar-hero talk. Far Beyond Driven (1994) unexpectedly hit US #1; The Great Southern Trendkill (1996) followed. The book cites Anselmo’s 1996 heroin overdose and Reinventing the Steel (2000) failing to stop the slide. After 9/11, grounded in an Irish hotel, the band argued and split. Anselmo went to Superjoint Ritual, then Down, with Brown also in Down; the Abbott brothers formed Damageplan. On 8 December 2004 a fan shot Darrell on stage. In 2012 Vinnie Paul floated a reunion with Zakk Wylde on guitar; Anselmo, via the Chinese edition, said a stage without Dimebag on his left would feel wrong.
body.zh:
1981 年于德州 Arlington 组建（早期有 glam 专辑）。自 Cowboys from Hell（1990）起为相关时期——Dimebag Darrell 捏音泛音、Rex Brown 贝斯、Vinnie Paul 咔嗒底鼓、Phil Anselmo 吠叫。

Walk（1992）以 groove 重于速度。他们把美国金属从 thrash 竞速推向停顿式掌闷 riff，后为 nu-metal 与 metalcore 继承。

Darrell Abbott 与 Vinnie Paul Abbott 1981 年在得克萨斯阿灵顿建队，最初是围绕 Darrell 技巧的 Kiss 式迷惑摇滚。Rex Brown（“Rexx Rocker”）加入；Terry Glaze 是早期待得最久的歌手。四张专辑由自有厂牌 Metal Magic 发行。1987 年 Philip Anselmo 接替 Glaze，方向转向硬摇滚与鞭挞；Atlantic 下属 Atco 签约。Cowboys from Hell（1990）是书中同步连复段与双踩的标记。Vulgar Display of Power（1992）用 Walk、A New Level、Fucking Hostile 回应鞭挞听众。世界巡演中 Darrell（此时称 Dimebag）被放在 Eddie Van Halen 与 Randy Rhoads 之后的吉他英雄序列里。Far Beyond Driven（1994）意外成为美国榜冠军；随后 The Great Southern Trendkill（1996）。书中写 Anselmo 1996 年海洛因过量，以及 Reinventing the Steel（2000）没能止住下滑。9·11 之后飞机停飞，乐队困在爱尔兰酒店里争吵并解散。Anselmo 去 Superjoint Ritual，再去 Down，Brown 也加入 Down；Abbott 兄弟组建 Damageplan。2004 年 12 月 8 日一名歌迷在台上开枪打死 Darrell。2012 年 Vinnie Paul 提议由 Zakk Wylde 担任吉他重组；中文版所引 Anselmo 说，左边没有 Dimebag 的舞台他会不舒服。

title.zh: 离开 glam 到 power groove

body.en:
Pantera starts as glam metal in Texas clubs—Metal Magic through Power Metal document the pre-Anselmo era.

Phil Anselmo joins in 1987; the band drops hairspray for hardcore-adjacent aggression.

Cowboys from Hell (1990) is the reset: dropped D tuning, Dimebag's Dean guitar, Vinnie Paul's triggered kick.
body.zh:
Pantera 起步于德州俱乐部 glam metal——Metal Magic 至 Power Metal 记录 Anselmo 前时期。

Phil Anselmo 1987 年加入；乐队甩掉发胶转向 hardcore 邻近侵略。

Cowboys from Hell（1990）是重置：降 D 调、Dimebag Dean 吉他、Vinnie Paul triggered 底鼓。

body.en:
Vulgar Display of Power (1992) sells millions—Walk becomes the riff many guitar students learn first. Mid-tempo, palm-muted, syncopated.

Fucking Hostile and Mouth for War push tempo; This Love adds ballad dynamic inside groove metal.

Terry Date production: drums forward, guitars scooped mid, Anselmo dry in front.
body.zh:
Vulgar Display of Power（1992）销量数百万——Walk 成许多吉他学生先学的 riff。中速、掌闷、切分。

Fucking Hostile 与 Mouth for War 推速度；This Love 在 groove metal 内加抒情动态。

Terry Date 制作：鼓前置、吉他 mid scoop、Anselmo 干声在前。

body.en:
Far Beyond Driven (1994) debuts at US #1—5 Minutes Alone and I'm Broken extend the groove approach. Strength Beyond Strength opens at extreme tempo.

The band fractures after Anselmo's heroin issues and Dimebag/Rex/Vinnie side projects. Dimebag is murdered on stage in 2004.

Groove metal legacy: nu-metal and metalcore cite Pantera for stop-start palm-muted riffs.
body.zh:
Far Beyond Driven（1994）美国 #1 debut——5 Minutes Alone 与 I'm Broken 延伸 groove 写法。Strength Beyond Strength 极端速度开场。

Anselmo 海洛因问题与 Dimebag/Rex/Vinnie side project 后乐队分裂。Dimebag 2004 年台上遇害。

groove metal 遗产：nu-metal 与 metalcore 引 Pantera 的停顿式掌闷 riff。

note.en: Glaze sang the Metal Magic glam albums. Anselmo from 1987 is the Cowboys / Vulgar / Far Beyond Driven lineup. Damageplan and Down are the post-split bands in the entry.
